parts.name: frame shell

physics.Basic_description: Grey painted metal frame forming the handle and barrel support structure.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural backbone for the tool, housing the trigger mechanism and supporting the cartridge.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the handle section firmly with a parallel jaw gripper to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal construction typical for tool frames, enclosing air volume.

parts.description: Grey painted metal frame forming the handle and barrel support structure.
parts.function: Provides the structural backbone for the tool, housing the trigger mechanism and supporting the cartridge.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the axle for the trigger lever rotation.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be grasped directly; avoid contact.
physics.reason: Pins are typically solid cylindrical rods to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
parts.function: Acts as the axle for the trigger lever rotation.

parts.name: rib rod 0

physics.Basic_description: Thin grey metal rods running along the length of the barrel support.
physics.Functional_description: Guide the plunger rod and provide structural rigidity to the open frame.
physics.Grasped_description: Slender rods that could bend; not suitable for primary grasping.
physics.reason: Thin guide rods are solid wire or rod stock.

parts.name: cartridge body

physics.Basic_description: Blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant material.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the viscous caulking compound under pressure.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped around the cylinder body, but surface may be slippery.
physics.reason: Standard caulking cartridges are thin-walled plastic tubes filled with paste.

parts.description: Blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant material.
parts.function: Holds the viscous caulking compound under pressure.

parts.name: front collar

physics.Basic_description: Grey plastic ring at the front end of the cartridge holder.
physics.Functional_description: Retains the cartridge in place and aligns the nozzle.
physics.Grasped_description: Small ring component, not a primary grasp point.
physics.reason: Molded plastic collar is a thin shell structure.

parts.description: Grey plastic ring at the front end of the cartridge holder.
parts.function: Retains the cartridge in place and aligns the nozzle.

parts.name: nozzle

physics.Basic_description: White conical plastic tip attached to the cartridge front.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of sealant and allows cutting to size the bead.
physics.Grasped_description: Fragile tip, avoid grasping to prevent breakage.
physics.reason: Nozzles are hollow cones to allow fluid passage.

parts.description: White conical plastic tip attached to the cartridge front.
parts.function: Directs the flow of sealant and allows cutting to size the bead.

parts.name: trigger blade

physics.Basic_description: Grey metal lever extending upwards from the handle area.
physics.Functional_description: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger and dispense sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Designed to be pressed by fingers; a gripper could press it to actuate.
physics.reason: Trigger levers are typically solid stamped or cast metal pieces for strength.

parts.description: Grey metal lever extending upwards from the handle area.
parts.function: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger and dispense sealant.

parts.name: plunger rod

physics.Basic_description: Long thin metal rod with a flat pusher plate at the rear end.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes against the cartridge plunger to extrude the sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped at the rear handle to manually retract or position.
physics.reason: Plunger rods are solid metal to transmit pushing force without buckling.

parts.description: Long thin metal rod with a flat pusher plate at the rear end.
parts.function: Pushes against the cartridge plunger to extrude the sealant.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
